user.title: Connect to your Sobro device
user.description:
Enter your Ayla Networks credentials.  These are the same credentials used by the Sobro mobile app.  App ID and App Secret are pre-filled with the values the official Sobro app uses (confirmed via the JoeBro reverse-engineering project) — only change them if Ayla/StoreBound rotates them.

For local/mock-server mode, override the Base URL fields to point at your local server (e.g. `http://192.168.1.100:3000`).

data_description.app_id: Pre-filled with the known Sobro app client ID; override only if it stops working

data_description.auth_url: Leave blank to use the default Ayla cloud endpoint
data_description.ads_url: Leave blank to use the default Ayla cloud endpoint
